message.text: I need to locate the SignIn RPC handler within the repository.
I should check the actual sign-in logic in APIV1Service.SignIn within server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go, around line 51.

This confirms the actual business-logic implementation of the SignIn RPC.

q04.
`AuthService.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` (implemented as `(s *APIV1Service) SignIn`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go:51`)

This is the core handler containing all the SignIn business logic (password and SSO credential validation, user lookup, token issuance via `doSignIn`). It's wired into both the gRPC service (`AuthServiceServer.SignIn`) and the Connect/HTTP gateway via a thin adapter in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:78`, which just forwards to this same method.
